en:
It is true that a gentleman should be
a master of many talents and skills...

That right! Gonta think gentleman
can do anything.

Why, gentleman could prolly get
Olympic medal and Nobel prize!

<CLT=cltMIND>That's more superhuman than gentleman.
Still, it's good to aim high...
Work hard, Gonta. I'm rooting for you.

Thanks! Gonta gonna work hard to
become gentleman!
<CLT=cltMIND>I think this conversation went well.

I don't think a gentleman needs to be
able to do *everything*...

No, gentlemen can do everything.
Gentlemen respected by community.

Gentlemen the smartest, strongest, nicest
people ever.

Gonta hope he can be gentleman like
that...

Gonta not feel confident... Bad enough
Gonta not smart like others...
<CLT=cltMIND>Damn, this is awkward...
Intelligence isn't the most important quality.
What?

Some gentlemen may indeed be smart, but
there are others whose gift is kindness.

You just have to find the best way
to be a gentleman for *you*.
Hm? Is something wrong?

Oh, sorry... Gonta just touched by Shuichi's
kind words...

Gonta never meet anyone like Shuichi
before.

Gonta will write your words in gentleman
journal before bedtime!

Because of Shuichi, Gonta can work hard
to become gentleman!

<CLT=cltMIND>Good, it seems like
we both had a lot of fun.

It's true that gentlemen are
typically quite intelligent.

Yes. Gonta not smart...so Gonta wonder if
he can even become gentleman...

I-It's okay! You have other skills
that you're good at, Gonta!
But gentleman supposed to be smart.

You can be a gentleman in the
way that suits you...

Can Gonta get smarter...?
Gonta not sure it possible...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's no use...
He's not listening at all...

<CLT=cltMIND>It seems like that didn't
go well...
